candidate.definition_en: A thing that completes or brings to perfection, or the full number or amount required.
candidate.explanation_ar: حاجة بتكمّل حاجة تانية وتخليها متناسقة أو تامة، أو العدد والنصاب الكامل المطلوب لشيء معين.

senses.definition_en: A thing that completes something else or makes it perfect.
senses.definition_ar: مُكمِّل؛ شيء يُتمم شيئاً آخر ويُبرز جودته.
examples: The wine was a perfect complement to the cheese.
The scarf is a nice complement to the dress.

senses.definition_en: The complete or required number or quantity.
senses.definition_ar: العدد الكامل أو النصاب التام المطلوب.
examples: The team needs a full complement of players.
The wine was a perfect complement to the cheese.
The scarf is a nice complement to the dress.
The team needs a full complement of players.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Complete' 'يكمل'.. الـ 'Complement' هو اللي بيعمل 'Complete' للصورة.
